root_cause: A pointer-only copy (shallow copy) of a buffer owned by another object's lifetime (AVCodecContext) is stored in a longer-lived structure (Decoder) without duplicating the buffer or establishing correct ownership/lifetime semantics, and no corresponding free/retain mechanism exists.
findings: In dec_open(), the newly introduced Decoder.subtitle_header field is assigned directly from ist->dec_ctx->subtitle_header (a pointer owned/managed by the decoder's AVCodecContext, i.e. by libavcodec). No copy of the underlying buffer is made; Decoder.subtitle_header is simply an alias to memory owned by the AVCodecContext.
